title: New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978, Chapter 62 (Electric, Gas and Water Utilities) - Public Utility Act
source_id: NMSA 1978, ch. 62, arts. 3 to 6 and 8 to 13 (Public Utility Act)
verified_how: Fetched the NM OneSource chapter page (item 4407, '?iframe=true' form) in a browser on 23 September 2026: page title 'Chapter 62 - Electric, Gas and Water Utilities - NMOneSource.com', collection 'Current New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978', date 2026; the table of contents lists 'ARTICLE 3 Public Utility Act; Preamble and Definitions', 'ARTICLE 6 Powers and Duties of Commission', 'ARTICLE 8 Duties and Restrictions Imposed Upon Public Utilities' and 'ARTICLE 13 Public Utility Act Miscellaneous Provisions', none marked repealed, while 'ARTICLE 3A Electric Utility Industry Restructuring Act of 1999 (Repealed.)', 'ARTICLE 5 New Mexico Public Utility Commission (Repealed.)' and 'ARTICLE 7 Natural Gas Price Protection (Repealed.)' are marked repealed.
notes: The Public Utility Act is spread across several articles of chapter 62 rather than sitting in one; rates, charges, billing and service obligations are in Articles 6, 8 and 13, and the regulator is the Public Regulation Commission (Article 19). Consumer billing detail is largely in PRC rules (NMAC title 17) made under this Act rather than in the statute.
